name: EMA 9/21 Crossover
description: A fast trend-follower that flips with short-term momentum, so it is always either long or short.
rule: Long when EMA9 crosses above EMA21, short on cross below. Stop-and-reverse.

name: EMA 20/50 Crossover
description: A slower crossover that ignores minor noise and rides medium-term trends.
rule: Long when EMA20 crosses above EMA50, short on cross below.

name: Supertrend (10, 3)
description: Draws a volatility-based trailing line and enters when price flips to the other side of it.
rule: Enter on Supertrend direction flip (ATR 10, factor 3).

name: MACD Signal Cross (12,26,9)
description: Catches momentum shifts as the MACD line moves above or below its signal line.
rule: Long when MACD crosses above signal line, short on cross below.

name: RSI 14 Mean Reversion (30/70)
description: Buys oversold dips and sells overbought rallies, exiting when RSI returns to the neutral 50.
rule: Long when RSI crosses up through 30, short when it crosses down through 70; exit at 50.

name: Bollinger Band Breakout (20, 2)
description: Treats a close outside the bands as the start of a strong move and trades in its direction.
rule: Long on close above upper band, short on close below lower band.

name: Bollinger Band Reversion (20, 2)
description: The opposite view to S06: closes outside the bands are overstretched, so it fades them back to the average.
rule: Fade closes outside the bands; exit at the middle band.

name: VWAP Reversion
description: Fades intraday moves that stretch too far from VWAP, the day's volume-weighted fair price, and targets a return to it.
rule: Fade a stretch of 1.5 ATR from session VWAP; exit at VWAP. Session-based, so best suited to 15m.

name: Opening Range Breakout (15m)
description: Lets the first 15 minutes set the day's range, then trades whichever side breaks first.
rule: Trade the break of the first 15-minute high/low. Session-based, so best suited to 15m.

name: Donchian 20 Breakout
description: The classic channel breakout: buy a new 20-bar high, sell a new 20-bar low.
rule: Long on 20-bar high break, short on 20-bar low break.

name: Heikin Ashi Trend
description: Smoothed candles filter out noise; a clean colour change with no opposing wick marks a new trend.
rule: Enter on colour change of Heikin Ashi candles with no opposing wick.

name: Stochastic (14,3,3) Cross
description: Looks for momentum turning up from oversold or down from overbought zones.
rule: Long on %K cross above %D below 20, short on cross below %D above 80.

name: ADX/DMI Trend (14, ADX>20)
description: Follows directional crossovers only when ADX confirms a real trend, cutting trades in sideways markets.
rule: Follow +DI/-DI crossovers only when ADX is above 20.

name: Ichimoku Cloud Breakout
description: A multi-factor trend check: price must clear the cloud with the short-term line above the base line.
rule: Long on close above the cloud with Tenkan above Kijun, short on the reverse.

name: Parabolic SAR (0.02, 0.2)
description: Trailing dots that follow price closely; the strategy reverses every time they flip sides.
rule: Stop-and-reverse on SAR flip.

name: Keltner Channel Breakout (20, 1.5 ATR)
description: An ATR-based volatility channel; a close outside it signals momentum in that direction.
rule: Long on close above upper channel, short below lower channel.

name: Previous Day High/Low Breakout
description: Trades the break of yesterday's high or low, levels the whole market is watching.
rule: Trade the break of the prior session's high/low.

name: Inside Bar Breakout
description: A bar that sits inside the previous one shows compression; the strategy trades the side it breaks.
rule: Enter on the break of an inside bar's high/low.

name: CPR / Pivot Breakout
description: Uses the Central Pivot Range from yesterday's prices; a break above or below sets the day's bias.
rule: Trade breaks of the Central Pivot Range (TC/BC) from prior-day data.

name: 200 EMA Pullback (with 20 EMA)
description: Buys dips to the 20 EMA in uptrends and sells rallies in downtrends, with the 200 EMA setting the direction.
rule: Trade pullbacks to the 20 EMA in the direction of the 200 EMA.

name: Triple EMA Ribbon (8/13/21)
description: Enters only when three EMAs are stacked in order with price beyond all of them: a clean, aligned trend.
rule: Long when EMA8>EMA13>EMA21 and price above all three; short on full reversal.

name: CCI (20) Extreme Reversal
description: Trades the turn as CCI comes back from extreme readings beyond plus or minus 100.
rule: Long when CCI crosses up through -100, short when it crosses down through +100.

name: Williams %R (14) Reversal
description: Catches reversals as Williams %R leaves its oversold or overbought zone.
rule: Long when %R crosses up through -80, short when it crosses down through -20.

name: Awesome Oscillator Saucer
description: Uses Awesome Oscillator patterns to time entries in the direction of the prevailing momentum.
rule: Enter on AO saucer/twin-peak signals in the direction of the zero-line bias.

name: TRIX (15) Signal Cross
description: A triple-smoothed momentum line whose signal cross filters out short-term noise.
rule: Long when TRIX crosses above its signal line, short on cross below.

name: ATR Volatility Breakout
description: Enters when one bar moves far more than its normal range, a sign that volatility is expanding.
rule: Long when close exceeds prior close + 1.5xATR(14), short on the mirror move down.

name: 52-Period Channel Breakout
description: A longer breakout system built to catch bigger trends from new 52-bar highs or lows.
rule: Long on a new 52-bar high close, short on a new 52-bar low close.

name: Pivot Point Reversal (Classic)
description: Fades the first test of the R1 or S1 pivot, aiming for a move back to the central pivot.
rule: Fade the first touch of R1/S1 pivot levels back toward the central pivot.

name: Fibonacci 61.8% Retracement Bounce
description: Joins the trend after a deep but healthy pullback to the 61.8% retracement level.
rule: Enter in the trend direction on a bounce from the 61.8% retracement of the last swing.

name: Volume Spike Breakout
description: Takes only the breakouts that are backed by at least double the usual volume.
rule: Trade breakouts confirmed by volume at least 2x the 20-bar average.

name: Three White Soldiers / Black Crows
description: Three strong candles in a row signal conviction; the strategy enters in that direction.
rule: Enter on three consecutive same-direction candles of increasing range.

name: MA Ribbon Compression Expansion
description: Waits for five EMAs to bunch tightly together, then trades the move as they fan out.
rule: Enter on breakout from a tight multi-EMA ribbon (5/10/15/20/25) once it expands.

name: RSI Divergence
description: When price makes a new extreme but RSI does not, momentum is fading; the strategy trades the reversal.
rule: Enter counter-trend on bullish/bearish RSI-price divergence at swing extremes.

name: Heikin Ashi Supertrend Combo
description: Two trend filters must agree before entry, which cuts down on whipsaws.
rule: Enter only when Heikin Ashi colour and Supertrend direction agree.

name: Gap and Go
description: Trades in the direction of a meaningful opening gap once the opening range confirms it.
rule: Trade in the direction of a session open gap beyond 0.3% once the opening range confirms it.

name: Double EMA (5/20) Scalp
description: Quick crossover trades on the 15-minute chart with tight stops.
rule: Fast EMA5/EMA20 crossover scalp with tight stop, intended mainly for 15m.

name: Bollinger %B Momentum
description: Measures where price sits inside the bands: strength near the top is bought, weakness near the bottom is sold.
rule: Long when %B crosses above 0.8 with rising momentum, short when it crosses below 0.2.

name: Linear Regression Channel Breakout
description: Treats a close outside a 50-bar regression channel as a break from the established path.
rule: Trade closes outside a 50-bar linear regression channel in the breakout direction.

name: Chaikin Money Flow Trend (20)
description: Combines money flow, the balance of buying and selling pressure, with price position against the 20 EMA.
rule: Long while CMF>0 and price above 20 EMA, short on the mirror condition.

name: Range Compression (NR7) Breakout
description: The narrowest bar of the last seven often comes before a big move; the strategy trades the breakout.
rule: Trade the breakout of the narrowest-range-of-7-bars (NR7) setup.

name: Dual Supertrend (7,2 / 14,3) Confirm
description: A fast and a slow Supertrend must agree, so short- and medium-term trends point the same way.
rule: Enter only when a fast and a slow Supertrend agree on direction.

name: MACD Zero-Line Cross
description: A slower momentum signal: the trend has turned when the MACD line crosses zero.
rule: Long when the MACD line crosses above zero, short when it crosses below zero.

name: RSI 14 Trend-Following (50 cross)
description: Uses RSI as a trend gauge: above 50 and rising is bullish, below 50 is bearish.
rule: Long when RSI crosses above 50 with rising slope, short on cross below 50.

name: Elder Ray Bull/Bear Power
description: Buys when sellers start weakening inside an uptrend, and the mirror for shorts.
rule: Long when Bear Power turns up while price is above EMA13, short on the mirror condition.

name: Hull Moving Average Trend (16)
description: Trades with the slope of the Hull MA, a fast moving average with very little lag.
rule: Long when price closes above a rising HMA(16), short when it closes below a falling HMA(16).

name: VWAP Trend Continuation
description: After a pullback, rejoins the day's trend once price reclaims VWAP.
rule: Trade in the direction of price relative to session VWAP once price reclaims it after a pullback.

name: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout
description: Band width at a 6-month low signals compression; the strategy trades the breakout that follows.
rule: Enter on the breakout that follows a Bollinger Bandwidth contraction to a 6-month low.

name: Camarilla Pivot Breakout
description: Breaks of yesterday's Camarilla H3 or L3 levels set the intraday direction.
rule: Trade breaks of the Camarilla H3/L3 levels derived from the prior session.

name: Three Bar Reversal
description: A three-bar higher-low or lower-high pattern at a swing extreme signals a turn.
rule: Enter counter-trend on a three-bar reversal pattern (higher low / lower high sequence) at a swing extreme.

name: ATR Trailing Stop Trend
description: Rides the trend behind a wide ATR trailing stop and reverses when the stop is hit.
rule: Stay long/short following price while trailing an ATR(14) x 2.5 stop; reverse on stop-out.

name: OBV Trend Confirmation
description: Volume must confirm price: enters when On-Balance Volume and price make new highs or lows together.
rule: Long when OBV makes a new high alongside price, short when OBV makes a new low alongside price.

name: Momentum Oscillator (10) Threshold
description: Compares price with 10 bars ago; crossing the 100 line marks a shift in momentum.
rule: Long when the 10-bar momentum oscillator crosses above 100, short when it crosses below 100.

name: Double Bollinger Band Trend (1 & 2 SD)
description: Stays in the trade while price holds the zone between the 1 and 2 standard-deviation bands.
rule: Long while price holds the 1-2 SD band zone above the mean, short in the mirror zone below.

name: Volume Weighted MA Cross (VWMA 10/30)
description: A crossover that gives more weight to high-volume bars, so moves backed by volume count more.
rule: Long when VWMA10 crosses above VWMA30, short on cross below.

name: RSI + MACD Dual Confirmation
description: Two momentum tools must agree before entry.
rule: Enter only when RSI>50 and MACD is above its signal line (and the mirror for shorts).

name: Pin Bar / Hammer Reversal
description: A long rejection wick at a swing extreme signals that the move is being rejected.
rule: Enter counter-trend on a pin bar or hammer with a wick at least twice the body, at a swing extreme.

name: Fractal Breakout (Williams Fractals)
description: Trades the break of the most recent confirmed swing high or low.
rule: Trade the break of the most recent confirmed Williams Fractal high/low.

name: Session VWAP Std-Dev Band Fade
description: Fades touches of the outer VWAP band back toward VWAP during the session.
rule: Fade a touch of the 2nd standard-deviation VWAP band back toward VWAP.

name: Choppiness Index Filtered Trend (14)
description: Takes EMA-cross signals only when the Choppiness Index says the market is trending, not ranging.
rule: Take EMA-cross trend signals only when the Choppiness Index is below 38 (trending regime).

name: End-of-Day Momentum Carry
description: Follows the last 30 minutes' direction into the next session as a short swing trade.
rule: Enter in the direction of the last 30 minutes' momentum for a swing hold into the next session.
